A '''scythe blade''' was a two-handed [[Sword/Legends|sword]] in use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]].

==Behind the scenes==
The scythe blade is a two-handed sword which appears as a player usable weapon in [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. It is crafted by Munitions Traders and the schematic is one of the many random loots players may find in their travels.
